_doc: Combat targets (M4, GPT's v1.2 decisions): what each target is and what it resists, explicit in the data so a skill asks the target instead of guessing. size: small | fixed. pullable: the Phantom Chain captures it and Chain Pull can drag it; launchable: Rising Slash can launch it. sealable: Explosive Seal can plant its mark on it (one that is not resists: the Seal misses, nothing detonates, nothing opens). A target that resists either takes the damage and a short stagger instead (stagger, s, at most 0.3). capture: the chain's hold and its diminishing returns — a capture within reset s of the previous one lasts the next factor of the full hold; past the last factor the target is immune until reset s after its last capture. juggle: after max_hits aerial follow-ups or max_time s in the air, whichever comes first, it cannot be launched again until it is back on its feet. down: s lying after a launch's landing; getup: s to rise; defeat_reset: s from defeat until it rises again whole; return_after: s without a blow before it walks back to its mark (when moved more than 1 m from it). spar (Stage C, a scripted training attacker — no full AI): standing on guard, it attacks its foe (the Samurai) with `attack` (data/abilities/automaton.json) when he is within trigger m and cone degrees of its facing, no sooner than after_hit s after a blow it took and than the attack's own cooldown allows; it never chases (trigger, cone and after_hit are provisional, for GPT's review). Down 0.45 s and get-up 0.9 s (the whole LayToIdle move played faster, blended — never cut short) are GPT's Stage B review values (v1.3); it confirmed the rest.
